name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / Labeled Sample Compression
details: Ordinary NCTD cannot bound labeled sample compression by any finite-valued function. On the private-coordinate cube, NCTD is one while LSC equals the compression number of the full n-cube and is greater than n/5. This does not refute a bound in projected NCTD, which is $\lceil n/2\rceil$ on this family. The reverse exact inequality is separately refuted by full cubes, but that witness only proves a bounded-ratio strict gap; a two-sided unbounded incomparability is not asserted.
proof_source: Full separation argument in the survey, cor:private-coordinate-compression-gap; endpoint proofs are database-owned.
references: \cite{KSZ2019}, Proposition 28(1). The database gives an explicit private-coordinate family and a direct compression identity.
witness_verification: On this family with n tending to infinity, NCTD is exactly one and LSC > n/5, by established endpoint value proofs. Thus LSC/(1+NCTD) diverges. The inequality is refuted, so the larger endpoint is parameter 2. No converse unbounded separation is claimed.
